metadata.description: Public skill collection by Maksym Stoianov

plugins.name: gitea-tea
plugins.description: Manages issues, pull requests, labels, comments, and releases on a Gitea server via the official `tea` CLI — structured issue descriptions with checklists, Gitea's native scoped/exclusive labels, and the PR review/merge workflow.

plugins.name: create-pr
plugins.description: Creates a GitHub pull request via the `gh` CLI with a title matching the repository's own detected convention and a body from its own PR template, instead of assuming one convention.

plugins.name: pre-publish-review
plugins.description: Reviews anything about to become public against three axes: whose material it contains, whether it is lawful where its readers are, and whether it excludes or insults anyone.
